items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 3917.15/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-07-06 was Rs 3917.15/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 300.84-10000.0/MWh).
